meta.title: If Your Furnace Ever Turns On In July… DON'T TOUCH THE THERMOSTAT

lines.text: If your furnace ever turns on in July…
lines.raw: If your furnace ever turns on in July… //

lines.text: leave it.

lines.text: Don't touch the thermostat.

lines.text: Then the whoosh.

lines.text: So it doesn't blow cold on you.
